_comment: Reviewed differences between the app and the ThingsBoard 4.4.1PAAS OpenAPI. Anything not listed here fails the audit. Every entry needs a reason.

endpoints./api/tenant/assetInfos: 404-only fallback to the Community Edition endpoint when /api/assetInfos/all is missing; absent from the PaaS spec on purpose (covered by repositories_fallback_test).
endpoints./api/tenant/deviceInfos: 404-only fallback to the Community Edition endpoint when /api/deviceInfos/all is missing; absent from the PaaS spec on purpose (covered by repositories_fallback_test).

GET /api/plugins/telemetry/{entityType}/.reason: Pre-4.4 fallback taken only on HTTP 404 from .../values/timeseries/history. Older servers serve ranges from this path; the 4.4 spec documents this GET as 'latest values' only.

responses.POST /api/rpc/twoway/{deviceId}: The spec documents the reply as `string`, but ThingsBoard returns the device's own JSON reply (any shape); the generic DeferredResult is lost by springdoc.

model_keys.TbNotification.read: Legacy/demo boolean flag; the 4.4.1 contract is `status` (SENT|READ). fromJson falls back to status when `read` is absent.
